sources.stated_purpose: First-level contracted indigent defense service inquiries, subject to appointment and eligibility.
sources.limitations: County department lists San Benito Defenders, Inc. and Harry Damkar as first-level contracted representation, extended through June 30, 2028. State Bar public professional profile publishes the matching law-office address. Other appointed counsel cover conflict and juvenile cases; do not infer one universal intake channel. Public defenders serve eligible clients in matters within their statutory or contracted remit; the address is not an independent medical-abuse investigation or general civil legal advice channel. Reconfirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction, eligibility and channel purpose before use. Do not send confidential information by ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
